speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Sixpence, the same as it was. Sit. The mutton is smaller. I am not apologising to a coin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence is sixpence. The plate can shrink. I have two sheets since Saturday.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then read. If I am to speak it, I want to have heard it before a yard does.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Read it fast. You said it must go fast. I will learn whether I have a word in the middle of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In shape no bigger then an Agot stone, on the forefinger of an Alderman.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: An alderman's finger. I am still chewing. Go on.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hazel-nut coach. She drives over lawyers' fingers, and over soldiers' necks.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Smaller still. Do not slow it for me. I asked for the speed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The parson's tithe-pig comes in here. I will not soften the pig.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The pig. I have stopped chewing. That was unkind to a man with his mouth full.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Master Garnish sent me in with a message.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Then give it, before the pig goes cold in the telling.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I had it at the door. I have not got it now.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it waits. The sheet will not. I am near the end of the fast one.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Finish it. I have not been given my word, and I can wait the length of a pig.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I am not asking for the pig again. I am asking for the ale to be nearer my hand than my elbow.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The ale is at your elbow. The sixpence did not buy a second dinner. Hear him out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the fast reading. Two sheets. The notes between the lines are not lines.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: One word from him, and none yet from you to me. The fast one is done. I am still waiting on mine.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: If the message comes back I will say it. It was about the tiring-house. That is all I can swear to.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: A forgotten message is the only kind I trust from a boy at a run. Sit at the end, and be quiet.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The pig was the stop. I have started chewing again. I am not proud of either fact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Chew. The fast one is finished. The second will be slower, and it will be the same pig.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Same sixpence, too. Nobody is to order as if the reading were a second meal.
